text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I begin work at nine and stay focused until five, with a short break for lunch. In the afternoon, I like to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or cycling. In the evening, I cook dinner, relax, and read a book before going to bed. I try to keep the same schedule every day because consistency helps me stay healthy, productive, and calm.
